# ArtHustle

> > ArtHustle offers comprehensive online watercolor painting courses and workshops for artists of all skill levels, from beginner tutorials to advanced landscape and portrait techniques.

ArtHustle is an online art education platform specializing in watercolor painting instruction. The platform features courses taught by experienced instructors like Rabi Alieva, covering techniques such as wet-on-wet painting, landscape composition, and portrait work, with offerings ranging from free beginner lessons to structured intermediate and advanced courses.

## Key Topics

- Watercolor painting
- Online courses
- Landscape painting
- Portrait painting
- Wet-on-wet technique

- Art techniques

## Core Courses & Programs

- [Courses](https://arthustle.org/courses): Main courses page listing watercolor and art education offerings.
- [Level Up Your Watercolor Painting Skills](https://arthustle.org/course/level-up-watercolor-online-class): Intermediate-level watercolor course for skill advancement.
- [Watercolor Woman Portrait - Wet-on-Wet Technique](https://arthustle.org/course/watercolor-woman-portrait-online-course): Step-by-step watercolor portrait tutorial using wet-on-wet technique.
- [Beautiful Cityscape Painting](https://arthustle.org/course/master-city-landscape): Online cityscape painting course covering Prague and color theory.
- [Watercolor Christmas Magic](https://arthustle.org/course/christmas-magic): Online watercolor course teaching DIY Christmas card creation.

## Landscape & Nature Painting

- [Watercolor Morning Landscape - Step-by-Step Tutorial](https://arthustle.org/course/watercolor-morning-landscape): Step-by-step watercolor tutorial for realistic morning landscapes.
- [City Landscape with Contrasting Light](https://arthustle.org/course/city-landscape-bike-with-watercolor): Watercolor course on painting city landscapes with light contrast.
- [Free Lesson - How To Draw a Sunset](https://arthustle.org/course/free-lesson-with-rabi-sunset): Free beginner watercolor tutorial on sunset landscape painting.
- [Free Lesson - Cozy Winter Illustration](https://arthustle.org/course/free-lesson-with-rabi-cozy-winter): Free watercolor course teaching portrait and winter illustration.

## Workshops & Events

- [3-Day Watercolor Portrait Workshop - Munich](https://arthustle.org/event/3-days-workshop-munich-watercolor-portrait): 3-day watercolor portrait workshop in Munich with instructor Rabi.
